paragraphs.text: Noranda-Zang was a human thaumaturge who ruled the land of Everlorne on an undisclosed plane .

Noranda-Zang's wife Celia died giving birth to the couple's son. Zang's son grew to be a huge man with black hair and piercing blue eyes. In the War of Thanopolis, Zang was defeated by Thane Du-Moriss IV , who stabbed him in the heart. Fortunately, Zang had prepared for this before the battle and took a new body.

For ten years, he searched for Thane, who was said to be one of the only minor wizards to create a haven of peace and plenty, to get revenge on him. Eventually, he found Kieve and summoned the frozen shade Caskor and asked him if the place was populated, and, if so, whether or not there was a wizard. Caskor replied that it was populated and that there was a wizard who ruled Kieve, but would not tell him who the wizard was. Zang slogged through a forest to get to one of the inland cities to find Kieve's ruler. He learned from an innkeeper that Thane was the ruler and where he lived. He knocked on his door, but no one seemed to be around. His invisible companion Gloom whispered in his ear that the door was unlocked and pushed open the door. She told him that Thane's wife Bayende , who was pregnant, was upstairs, and suggested that they kill her. Zang agreed, thinking that killing her would steal from Thane both his wife and the heir to his kingdom. After his wife's death, Thane searched for seventeen years to find Zang. He eventually found Everlorne and killed Zang's son.

In stories before Mirage , any sufficiently powerful wizard could become a planeswalker, and the terms were often used interchangeably. Noranda-Zang is described as having traveled on "the long path between worlds" in his hunt for Thane, possibly implying that he was a planeswalker. His ability to reconstitute in a new body following his ostensible death also lends credence to this theory.
